# Third-party components

The MIT license in `LICENSE` covers original DevWorkspace code. Dependencies, SDKs, fonts, icons and Windows components retain their own terms. It does not grant rights to commercial dependencies.

| Component | License / terms |
| --- | --- |
| DevExpress WPF Docking, Grid and Themes | Commercial DevExpress license; building and redistributing must comply with [DevExpress licensing](https://www.devexpress.com/support/eulas/). |
| .NET and WPF | MIT and bundled third-party notices supplied by Microsoft. |
| Velopack | MIT; see the installed NuGet package and [upstream repository](https://github.com/velopack/velopack). |
| Markdig | BSD-2-Clause; see the installed NuGet package and [upstream repository](https://github.com/xoofx/markdig). |

Preserve dependency license files and notices when redistributing. Review the actual restored package contents for the versions you distribute. Optional tools such as Git, GitHub CLI, Docker and OSV-Scanner are separate products with their own terms.
